correctness.rationale: The identity is correct. Conditioning on all non-triangle edges leaves exactly three exterior connectivity states. If two exterior components meet the triangle, the expected component-rank reduction is one minus \((1-p)^2\); if three components meet it, the expected reduction is \(3p-p^3\). Comparing each with the fully open reduction gives the exact negative component covariance. Adding the covariance of the three triangle-edge indicators yields the positive cycle-rank expression and its bounds. In the sparse complete graph with \(p=c/n\), a simple-path union bound for fixed \(c<1\) makes the three vertices exterior-disconnected with probability one minus order \(1/n\), giving the stated constants. A fresh exact enumeration on a four-vertex triangle-with-tail graph at \(p=2/5\) gave component covariance \(-864/15625\) and cycle-rank covariance \(936/15625\), exactly matching the formulas.
